results.name: test_spur_cascade

results.name: test_core_redundant_no_suppression

results.name: test_precision_independent_faults

results.name: test_flap_dampening

results.name: test_determinism
results.summary: Identical input ordering yields byte-identical correlation output — no scoring, no ML.
